title: Derived Kunneth isomorphism for base-flat quasi-coherent sheaves over an affine base

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Quasi-coherent sheaves on schemes with affine diagonal, finite affine covers, cup products andCech resolutions, K-flat tensor products, Leray and flat cohomology base change. The localK-flat argument is retained.

core_obligations: Identify the canonical derived Kunneth map with the explicit comparison of the twoCech complexes and their product-cover total complex.
Construct compatible dimension-shifting exact sequences that preserve base-flatness, reduce to degree-zero cohomology, and finish by relativeCech, Leray and base change.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the canonical derived Kunneth map with the explicit comparison of the twoCech complexes and their product-cover total complex.
Construct compatible dimension-shifting exact sequences that preserve base-flatness, reduce to degree-zero cohomology, and finish by relativeCech, Leray and base change.

difficulty_reason: The base is an arbitrary affine scheme, and only the two sheaves are assumed base-flat. The compatible dimension shift and canonical-map comparison are concrete H2 work beyond the field-valued cohomology formula.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.
